# Platform settings · Payments

## Payment settings

<a id="PaymentUSDRate"></a>

### CNY collection rate

Key `PaymentUSDRate` · Type float · Unit CNY/USD · Range 0– · Default `7.3`

Where: Platform settings › Payments › Payment settings

How many yuan one US dollar of top-up costs at gateways that charge in CNY. A top-up of $X costs X x this rate there, times the gateway's own rate, plus its fee. It changes neither balances nor the quota a top-up buys, and USD gateways ignore it. Use the real exchange rate; for promotions use top-up discounts or a gateway's rate.

Examples:

- `7.3` A $100 top-up costs ¥730 at a CNY gateway and $100 at a USD gateway; both buy 50,000,000 quota.
- `7.1` The same top-up costs ¥710: you take ¥20 less for the same quota.

See also: [Top-up discounts](./payment.md#RechargeDiscount) · [Minimum top-up](./payment.md#PaymentMinAmount) · [Payment cost](./billing.md#PaymentCostPercent)

<a id="PaymentMinAmount"></a>

### Minimum top-up

Key `PaymentMinAmount` · Type int · Unit USD · Range 0– · Default `1`

Where: Platform settings › Payments › Payment settings

The smallest top-up a user or an organization can pay, in whole US dollars. Smaller amounts are refused before a payment is created. 0 and 1 both allow any amount from $1.

Examples:

- `1` Users can top up any whole amount from $1 (500,000 quota).
- `10` A $5 top-up is refused; $10 is the least, buying 5,000,000 quota.

See also: [CNY collection rate](./payment.md#PaymentUSDRate) · [Top-up discounts](./payment.md#RechargeDiscount)

<a id="PaymentCallbackAddress"></a>

### Payment callback address

Key `PaymentCallbackAddress` · Type url · Default `empty` · rarely changed

Where: Platform settings › Payments › Payment settings

The address payment gateways send their payment notices to, when it differs from the server address. Empty uses the gateway's own callback domain, then the server address. Notices go to <address>/api/payment/notify/<gateway id> (EPay: <address>/api/user/epay/notify), which must be reachable from the internet, or paid orders are never credited.

Examples:

- `https://pay.example.com` Gateways call https://pay.example.com/api/payment/notify/<gateway id> while users keep using the main domain.

See also: [Server address](./site.md#ServerAddress)

<a id="RechargeDiscount"></a>

### Top-up discounts

Key `RechargeDiscount` · Type json · Default `{}`

Where: Platform settings › Payments › Payment settings

Discounts for fixed top-up amounts: a JSON object from a whole-dollar amount to the share of the price the user pays. Only those exact amounts are discounted; others pay full price. The quota is never discounted: $100 always buys 100 x 500,000 quota at the default quota per unit. A gateway's percentage fee is charged on the discounted price. Empty means no discounts.

Examples:

- `{"100":0.95}` A $100 top-up costs $95 (¥693.50 at a CNY rate of 7.3) and buys 50,000,000 quota; $99 or $101 pay full price.
- `{"50":0.98,"200":0.9}` $50 costs $49 and $200 costs $180; every other amount pays full price.

See also: [CNY collection rate](./payment.md#PaymentUSDRate) · [Minimum top-up](./payment.md#PaymentMinAmount) · [Quota per dollar](./site.md#QuotaPerUnit)
